The server\nbinds to `127.0.0.1` and reads the port from the `PORT` environment variable\n(defaulting to `3000`).\n\nVerify it is listening:\n\n```bash\ncurl http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/health\n# => {\"ok\":true}\n```\n\nThe server runs in the foreground; stop it with `Ctrl-C` or by sending\n`SIGTERM` to the process.\n\n## Entry point and file layout\n\n- `run.sh` — the launcher required by the harness.\n- `server.rb` — the entry point. Requires standard-library gems and all\n  domain/HTTP modules in dependency order, then starts `HttpServer`.\n- `lib/config.rb` — runtime constants (`HOST`, `PORT`, `DB_PATH`,\n  `SCHEMA_VERSION`).\n- `lib/combat.rb` — combat sessions, initiative, and turn/condition tracking.\n- `lib/compendium.rb` — monster and item reference entries.\n- `lib/campaigns.rb` — campaign metadata, characters, and The schema statements use\n  `IF NOT EXISTS`, and `reset!` drops every application table (including\n  `users`) before recreating them, so the server begins each run with a clean\n  state.\n- `Persistence.soft_reset!` drops every application table *except* `users`, then\n  recreates the schema. and testing\n\n### Adding a new endpoint\n\n1. If the endpoint is pure computation, put it in the appropriate domain\n   module (e.g., `PureRules`, `PlayerHandbook`, `DmTools`) and have it return\n   a Hash on success or `nil` on invalid input.\n2. If the endpoint needs persistence, add it to the module that owns the data\n   (e.g., `Combat`, `Campaigns`, `Compendium`) and return a `[:tag, data]`\n   tuple.\n3. Wire the endpoint into `Router.route` with an explicit `method`/`path`\n   check and call `handle_result` or `json_response` / `error_response` as\n   needed.\n4. AND username = ?',\n        [campaign_id, actor[:username]]\n      )\n      next [:forbidden] unless owner == actor[:username] || is_member\n\n      phase = current_actor == owner ? 'dm' : 'player'\n\n      members = d.execute(\n        'SELECT username FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? ORDER BY username',\n        campaign_id\n      ).map { |row| row[0] }\n      queue = members.flat_map { |m| [m, 'dm'] }\n\n      deadline = turn_number.is_a?(Integer) ? turn_number + 1 : nil\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'campaign_id' => campaign_id,\n        'current_actor' => current_actor,\n        'phase' => phase,\n        'turn_number' => turn_number,\n        'queue' => queue,\n        'overdue' => false,\n        'logical_deadline' => deadline\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.my_turn(campaign_id, actor)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign = d.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT current_actor FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?',\n        campaign_id\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign\n\n      member = d.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT character_id, name FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? WHERE id = ?',\n        [owner, campaign_id]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'sequence' => next_sequence,\n        'kind' => 'action',\n        'actor' => actor[:username],\n        'type' => type,\n        'text' => text,\n        'next_actor' => 'dm'\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.resolve(campaign_id, actor, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    text = payload['text']\n    return [:invalid] unless text.is_a?(String) && !text.empty?\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign = d.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT owner, current_actor, turn_number FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?',\n        campaign_id\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign\n\n      owner, current_actor, turn_number = campaign\n      next [:conflict] unless owner == actor[:username]\n      next [:conflict] unless current_actor == owner\n\n      members = d.execute(\n        'SELECT username FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? ORDER BY username',\n        campaign_id\n      ).map { |row| row[0] }\n\n      next [:conflict] if members.empty?\n\n      # Advance to the player after whoever submitted the last player turn\n      # (action, travel, or rest), wrapping around at the end of the sorted party list.\n      last_action_row = d.get_first_row(\n        \"SELECT actor FROM play_narrations WHERE campaign_id = ? AND kind IN ('action', 'travel', 'rest') ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1\",\n        campaign_id\n      )\n      last_actor = last_action_row ? last_action_row[0] : nil\n\n      next_actor = if last_actor && members.include?(last_actor)\n                     members[(members.index(last_actor) + 1) % members.length]\n                   else\n                     members[0]\n                   end\n\n      next_sequence = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence), 0) + 1 FROM play_narrations WHERE campaign_id = ?',\n        campaign_id\n      )\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO play_narrations (campaign_id, sequence, kind, actor, text) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [campaign_id, next_sequence, 'resolution', 'dm', text]\n      )\n\n      new_turn_number = turn_number.to_i + 1\n\n      d.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaigns SET current_actor = ?, turn_number = ? WHERE id = ?',\n        [next_actor, new_turn_number, campaign_id]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'sequence' => next_sequence,\n        'kind' => 'resolution',\n        'actor' => 'dm',\n        'text' => text,\n        'next_actor' => next_actor,\n        'turn_number' => new_turn_number\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.nudge(campaign_id, actor, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    message = payload['message']\n    return [:invalid] unless message.is_a?(String) && !message.empty?\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign = d.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT owner, status, current_actor, nudge_count FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?',\n        campaign_id\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign\n\n      owner, status, current_actor, nudge_count = campaign\n      next [:forbidden] unless owner == actor[:username]\n      next [:conflict] unless status == 'active' && current_actor\n\n      new_nudge_count = nudge_count.to_i + 1\n      d.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaigns SET nudge_count = ?
